caption: The drawing features an arrangement of floral motifs and plants on a light beige background. The bottom and left borders are heavily decorated with vines, flowers, and leaves rendered in shades of red, pink, blue, green, and yellow. Flowers vary in shape and size, with some resembling sunflowers, roses, and tulips, and the leaves are mostly green with occasional yellow tones. The lower right quadrant contains a cluster of red and pink flowers with green stems and leaves, while the upper right corner displays a stylized fish-like figure in brown near a small red and pink flower. The central and upper portions of the drawing are less dense, with a few isolated floral motifs colored in blue, yellow, pink, and red. The entire composition is embroidered on fabric, with all forms outlined and filled in using colored thread, creating a detailed and colorful pattern on a neutral background.
title: Embroidered Christening Blanket
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
